items.dod: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile exits 0 on Node 22+ and pnpm -r ls --depth -1 lists the eleven workspace packages
items.note: First attempt this session exited 1 with ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS: pnpm-workspace.yaml has allowBuilds.esbuild set to the literal placeholder string "set this to true or false" (committed at 50a5ad5), which pnpm treats as an unapproved build. Probing with `pnpm approve-builds` (unattended) rewrote that line to `esbuild: false` in the working tree; that accidental edit was reverted with `git checkout -- pnpm-workspace.yaml` before continuing. A local pnpm build-approval cache (outside the repo) was left set from the probe, so the recorded install.log run exits 0 with 11 workspace packages, but a genuinely fresh clone/store will hit the same ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS failure until a human runs `pnpm approve-builds` and commits a real true/false value in pnpm-workspace.yaml.
